page.overview:
Who is Kiyosa Natomo?

Kiyosa held the position for twenty-six years until her death in the series. She was Medanor Eramandos's successor and Catala Lucanvalle's predecessor., Chapter 24 The White Tower}}

Her strength of will and strong personality helped her manage Tower affairs, making her a strong Amyrlin.

Due to her Japanese-inspired name, it is likely that she hailed from the Borderlands.
